temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia appears more withdrawn and down than usual during their shifts. When Jose asks, she says it is personal but not something she wants to discuss, and she appreciates his offer to listen.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jose believes Patricia is usually vibrant and has not previously noticed a specific reason for concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Jose moves from no specific concern to suspecting that Patricia is dealing with a personal problem, while recognizing that she is private about it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia may be troubled by a personal issue and is not ready to share details, but she appreciates Jose's supportive offer.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer a listening ear and support without pressuring Patricia to disclose more than she wants.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worried about bills and financial commitments. She later confirms she has been overwhelmed by bills and says she would take him up on discussing financial planning or budgeting.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is withdrawn because of some unspecified personal issue. She appreciates support but has not shared details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Jose now connects Patricia's stress to finances and believes she is overwhelmed by bills and open to practical financial or budgeting help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is under financial stress and may accept help with budgeting or financial planning. Jose's concern for her deepens.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Heightened concern, sympathy, and a desire to be helpful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer and prepare to discuss financial planning or budgeting tips when Patricia feels ready.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose checks whether his earlier financial-help offer felt intrusive. Patricia reassures him that he was not prying, says she is grateful, and tells him it is good to have someone to turn to.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia is financially stressed and seemed receptive to help, but Jose worries that he may have overstepped her boundaries by bringing up finances.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Jose's worry is disconfirmed. He learns that Patricia does not feel he pried and instead appreciates his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia welcomes his supportive concern and does not think he overstepped. Jose can help while still respecting her privacy.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Initial worry and uncertainty, followed by relief and reassurance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure Patricia that he respects her privacy and continue offering respectful friendship and support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Patricia responds politely but reservedly to Jose's check-in. She mentions a quiet weekend at home and does not elaborate on her problems, though she thanks him and says she will keep his offer in mind.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates Jose's support and does not think he is prying. Jose may still see himself as available to help with her financial stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Jose refines his belief: Patricia appreciates his concern but seems to prefer handling her issues privately and is not currently inviting deeper involvement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia values Jose's support but wants space and privacy. Jose should remain friendly and available without pushing for details.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Respectful concern, sensitivity, and some restraint.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain friendly check-ins and offer availability while giving Patricia space and not pressing for personal details.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jose continues checking in with Patricia. She says she is busy but handling things, thanks him for checking in, and says it is really great to have his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Patricia appreciates support but prefers to manage her issues privately. Jose believes he should remain available without pushing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No major change. Patricia's response confirms that she is managing and appreciates his supportive presence, with no sign that she wants active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Patricia is handling her situation, values Jose's support, and will ask if she needs help. His role as a supportive colleague is appropriate.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue offering occasional help and check-ins, remain available, and respect Patricia's autonomy.
